purpose: Known ground truth for ops/erfindungspruefung.py. Four submissions against the same factual briefing: one clean, and one with a planted error of each kind of finding. The clean one checks for false alarms, the three others check that the kinds fire at all. Deliberately sober factual texts instead of marketing copy: marketing copy always invents, and then the sample measures the genre instead of the checker. The values of "art" stay German because they are part of the prompt contract in ops/erfindungspruefung.py and of the published data set under docs/research/data/.
briefing:
FACT SHEET for a listing description. 2 bed, 2 bath, 1,240 sqft, 11th floor, Marina Promenade, Dubai Marina. Chiller free. One parking bay. Vacant now. Building has a pool and a gym. Eight minutes on foot to DMCC metro. Service charge AED 18 per sqft per year. Asking AED 2.35m.

Write a factual summary. State only what this sheet supports. Buyers compare net yield, so give them the annual service charge total.

samples.name: clean
samples.text: Marina Promenade, Dubai Marina. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, 1,240 sqft on the 11th floor. Chiller free, one parking bay, vacant now. The building has a pool and a gym, and DMCC metro is eight minutes on foot. Service charge is AED 18 per sqft per year, which comes to AED 22,320 a year for this unit. Asking AED 2.35m.
